title: International Field Service Engineer
description:
To ensure all the regions of Bangladesh are maintained and fully operational according to the contractual obligation for the Accounts. This position will involve travelling the Bangladesh if required and ensuring the location is properly maintained. 
 JOB PURPOSE: Create work plans for locomotives and communicating them to the customers and FSEs in a timely fashion. Work with minimal supervision. Working safely on customer property, following all safety rules. Ensuring Auditing materials and completing cycle counts are completed by staff weekly. Entering warranty orders and requisitions when required. Follow up on new deliveries, and work with engineering to maintain highest quality of performance. Advising customer tradesmen on testing and troubleshooting procedures. Co-ordinate activities regarding tech issues and material requirements with all sheds. Effectively troubleshoot and repair all mechanical & electrical systems of locomotives, both on and off site. Take Corrective action as needed for all safety and work-related issues at all sheds. Responsible for long- and short-term planning and meeting operation schedules Communicate information in a timely manner to all employees. Assure proper maintenance of facility equipment and machinery is in working condition. Effectively troubleshoot and repair all mechanical & electrical system of a locomotive. Administer all policies and procedures that relate to the facilities at individual sheds. Ensure all governmental agency inspection requirements and/or procedures are accounted for and documented. Ensure compliance with policies and procedures with all staff Ensure good safety practices and housekeeping to all sheds Co-ordinate with engineering in LaGrange with all issues with issues with new locomotives. 
 JOB DUTIES : 1. Provides technical advice to customers regarding proper facilities, tooling, maintenance practices, and operation of product to maximize reliability and performance. 2. Assists customers with investigating and correcting product difficulties. 3. Support warranty and Locomotive Commissioning activity and engage in MSA projects if requirement arises. 4. Maintaining inventory details of materials. 5. Develop technical best practices. 
 BACKGROUND/EXPERIENCE: B.E. / B. Tech. (Mechanical /Electrical / Electronics / Instrumentation / Automation /) with 3 - 6 years OR Diploma (Electrical / Electronics / Instrumentation / Automation / Mechanical) with 7 - 8 OR ITI (Electrical / Electronics / Instrumentation / Mechanical) with 8 - 10 years of experience in locomotive services and maintenance. 
 Preferred Prior railroad locomotive field experience or knowledge of railroad operations Previous locomotive experience in mechanical or electrical troubleshooting Knowledge of rail industry safety rules. Experience with SAP and D365. Knowledge of unit service and warranty policies and procedures.

Key Skills: International,Field service,Contracts,Diesel,Locomotive,Compensation,Servicing,Maintenance

title: Credit Analyst-Working Capital Visakhapatnam-Manager
description:
About Commercial Banking Group: The Commercial Banking Group is responsible for delivering One Axis to clients with a turnover between Rs 10 Crs. to Rs 250 Crs. by offering products and solutions around forex, trade, payments, cash management and tax payments along with retail products like salary, trust services, forex, commercial card, credit cards etc About the Role: Credit Analysts are responsible for evaluating a proposal by analyzing and presenting information about the borrower across areas like market, financial statements, technical rations, management, etc. Credit Analysts work closely with Relationship Managers to understand the profile of their clients and their requirements Key Responsibilities Responsible for preparation of CAM and putting up various notes (review, replies to observations from the Risk department, etc.) Responsible for assessing the credit worthiness, and preparation of credit proposals, by fitting borrower requirement within the existing product suite and credit policy guidelines Conduct review / renewal of accounts Ensure maintenance of acceptable TAT for various tasks such as conducting rating, preparation of appraisal note, renewals, etc. Qualifications: Optimal qualification for success on the job is: Graduates with a good academic background CAs/Management Graduates/ICWAs will be preferred Role Proficiencies: For successful execution of the job, the candidate should possess the following: Good understanding of financial ratios and concepts Good communication (both verbal and written) skill in both English and the local language 
 Note: CA Female and Male with Previous experience as credit analyst in working capital division is accepted(mini 3/ 5 years) Interested candidate share you CV: Ssrinand.Balaji@axis.bank.in or 8248675170 Job location: Vizag Grade :Manager.(depending up on the Experience)

Key Skills: Corporate,Ca,Sheet,Working capital,Balance Sheet analysis,Large,Analysis,Credit
